TL;DR: This paper shows how different decoherence channels in a two-dimensional EWL Stag Hunt quantum game map the system to an Ising model, producing depolarization-driven criticality while demonstrating that microscopic two-qubit entanglement is distinct from the effective interaction strength.
摘要翻译

物理退相干可以在改变相应相互作用群体的热力学 regimes 的同时，保持量子博弈的微观策略中性条件。我们通过将 Eisert--Wilkens--Lewenstein（\textit{EWL}）Stag Hunt 博弈作为独立最近邻相互作用嵌入方格晶格来证明这一点。对于受限策略 $\mathsf{Q}=i\mathbb{Z}$ 和 $\mathsf{D}=i\mathbb{Y}$，我们确定了相位阻尼、退极化和振幅阻尼下的含噪两人收益矩阵，并将其精确映射为依赖于信道的 Ising 参数 $\mathfrak{J}(Γ,p)$ 和 $\mathfrak{H}(Γ,p)$。相位阻尼和退极化展现出最鲜明的对比：它们共享相同的微观中性分支 $\mathfrak{H}=0$，而只有退极化以 $(1-p)^2$ 的形式抑制相互作用。在 $β=1$ 时，这产生了精确的由退极化驱动的方格晶格临界点 $p_{*}\approx 0.233460\ldots$，而相位阻尼沿同一中性分支保持在有序共存区。蒙特卡罗有限尺寸标度与二维 Ising 临界性一致，并将 $p_{*}$ 以下的场驱动共存与 $p_{*}$ 以上的平滑交叉区分开来。振幅阻尼还揭示了对信道放置的强烈依赖性：策略后中性分支在 $p=1/3$ 处达到 $Γ=0$，然后消失。资源负性进一步表明，微观两比特纠缠与集体相互作用强度是不同的量。由此得到的扩展晶格仍然是普通的经典 Ising 系统。

Abstract

Physical decoherence can preserve the microscopic strategic neutrality condition of a quantum game while changing the thermodynamic regime of the corresponding interacting population. We demonstrate this for an Eisert--Wilkens--Lewenstein (\textit{EWL}) Stag Hunt embedded as independent nearest neighbor encounters on a square lattice. For the restricted strategies $\mathsf{Q}=i\mathbb{Z}$ and $\mathsf{D}=i\mathbb{Y}$, noisy two-player payoff matrices are determined for phase damping, depolarization, and amplitude damping and mapped exactly to channel dependent Ising parameters $\mathfrak{J}(Γ,p)$ and $\mathfrak{H}(Γ,p)$. Phase damping and depolarization show the clearest contrast: they share the same microscopic neutrality branch $\mathfrak{H}=0$, while only depolarization suppresses the interaction as $(1-p)^2$. At $β=1$, this produces an exact depolarization-driven square-lattice critical point at $p_{*}\approx 0.233460\ldots$, whereas phase damping remains in the ordered coexistence regime along the same neutrality branch. Monte Carlo finite size scaling is consistent with two-dimensional Ising criticality and distinguishes field driven coexistence below $p_{*}$ from a smooth crossover above it. Amplitude damping additionally reveals a strong dependence on channel placement: the post-strategy neutrality branch reaches $Γ=0$ at $p=1/3$ and then disappears. Resource negativity further shows that microscopic two-qubit entanglement and collective interaction strength are distinct quantities. The resulting extended lattice remains an ordinary classical Ising system.

摘要翻译

我们提出了一个统一的框架，利用量子计算范式及其经典张量网络等价形式来模拟地震波传播。我们详细阐述了基于量子电路的显式有限差分时域(FDTD)求解二维声波方程的公式，并将该量子架构映射为张量列车表示，即矩阵乘积态(MPS)。MPS求解器使得在经典高性能计算系统上对大尺度波场动力学进行确定性模拟成为可能。我们通过在Marmousi模型上计算二维地震波场来验证MPS表示的有效性。结果表明，MPS表示为计算和扩展波场传播提供了一个可行的方向。

Abstract

We present a cohesive framework for simulating seismic wave propagation utilizing quantum computing paradigms and their classical tensor network equivalents. We detail a quantum circuit-based formulation for the explicit finite-difference time-domain (FDTD) solution of the two-dimensional acoustic wave equation and map this quantum architecture onto a tensor train representation, namely for Matrix Product State (MPS). The MPS solver enables deterministic simulation of large-scale wavefield dynamics on classical high-performance computing systems. We demonstrate the MPS representation by computing 2D seismic wavefields on the Marmousi model. Our results indicate that the MPS representation is a viable direction for computing and scaling wavefield propagation.

摘要翻译

Abstract

We provide a simple physics argument as well as a rigorous proof using sector theory, and instantiate our result concretely in Levin-Wen models. We also show that the associated ground state does not allow for quantum steering despite being a pure state. Finally, we show that this ground state violates approximate Haag duality, disproving the conjecture that all gapped ground states satisfy this condition. Our result implies that there are gapped phases of matter where Haag duality fails at every point in the phase.

摘要翻译

热场双态（TFD）态的变分制备可能需要很深的量子电路，尤其对于相互作用多体系统而言。因此，在降低电路深度的同时保持高保真度，对于在含噪量子处理器上制备TFD态至关重要。我们通过将多角度量子近似优化算法（ma-QAOA）应用于TFD态制备，并引入两种自顶向下的顺序角度剪枝算法来研究该问题。从优化后的初始ma-QAOA电路出发，两种算法依次移除具有较小优化角度的泡利串演化，并在每次移除后重新优化剩余参数。我们将这些算法应用于高斯和二进制Sachdev--Ye--Kitaev（SYK）模型的稠密与稀疏情形。我们发现ma-QAOA能够高保真地制备目标TFD态，且顺序小角度剪枝在降低电路深度的同时保持高保真度，尤其在低温下效果显著。此外，在顺序小角度剪枝中使用重优化后的代价函数可进一步提升保真度。对于$N=10$、$β=10$的二进制稀疏SYK模型，$88.8\%$--$92.1\%$的非局域泡利串演化被移除，同时平均保真度保持在约$95\%$。最后，我们提出了将顺序剪枝算法扩展到量子-经典混合实现的方案。

Abstract

Variational preparation of thermofield double (TFD) states can require deep quantum circuits, particularly for interacting many-body systems. Reducing these circuits while retaining high fidelity is therefore crucial for TFD-state preparation on noisy quantum processors. We study this problem by applying the multi-angle quantum approximate optimization algorithm (ma-QAOA) to TFD-state preparation and introducing two top-down sequential angle-pruning algorithms. Starting from the optimized initial ma-QAOA circuit, both algorithms sequentially remove Pauli-string evolutions with small optimized angles and reoptimize the remaining parameters after each removal. We apply these algorithms to Gaussian and binary Sachdev--Ye--Kitaev (SYK) models in both dense and sparse cases. We find that ma-QAOA prepares the target TFD states with high fidelity and that sequential small-angle pruning retains high fidelity while reducing the circuit depth, particularly at low temperature. Moreover, using the post-reoptimization cost in sequential small-angle pruning further improves the fidelity. For the binary sparse $N=10$ SYK model at $β=10$, $88.8\%$--$92.1\%$ of the nonlocal Pauli-string evolutions are removed while retaining an average fidelity of approximately $95\%$. Finally, we propose extensions of the sequential pruning algorithms toward quantum--classical hybrid implementation.

摘要翻译

非厄米物理赋予非阿贝尔系统以非交换辫子模式为特征的奇异拓扑。不同非厄米来源之间的竞争性相互作用可能引发新颖的拓扑效应。在此，我们提出了一个广义的Hatano-Nelson模型，包含高阶非互易跳跃、非阿贝尔规范场以及交错增益-损耗过程，展示了经历EP介导的拓扑相变的Hopf链环辫子的奇异拓扑结构。我们证明，混合多个非互易通道会使系统进入高度复杂的嵌套复能量Hopf链环辫子，并将拓扑景观扩展至更高阶的辫子扇区。此外，利用双正交本征矢量追踪，我们通过相位角参数平面中的最大彼得曼因子绘制了奇异相边界的结构演化。我们表明，增益-损耗非厄米性驱动了一种拓扑交叉，其中扩展的奇异轮廓收缩为孤立区域。对Hopf链环辫子的EP介导拓扑相变及其相关丰富奇异相图的演示，可能为鲁棒、容错的通信信道和量子计算平台提供新的物理见解与应用前景。

Abstract

Non-Hermitian physics endows the non-Abelian systems with exceptional topology characterized by non-commutative braid patterns. Interplay of distinct competing sources of non-Hermiticity may induce novel topological effects. Here, we provide a generalized Hatano-Nelson model with higher-order nonreciprocal hoppings, non-Abelian gauge fields, and staggered gain-loss processes showing the exceptional topological structure of the Hopf-link braids that undergoes a EP-mediated topological phase transition. We demonstrate that mixing multiple nonreciprocal channels drives the system into highly intricate, nested complex energy Hopf-link braids and expands the topological landscape up to higher-order braiding sectors. Furthermore, utilizing biorthogonal eigenvector tracking, we map the structural evolution of the exceptional phase boundaries via the maximum Petermann factor in the phase angle parameter planes. We show that the gain-loss non-Hermiticity drives a topological crossover where the extended exceptional contours constrict into isolated regimes. The demonstration of EP-mediated topological phase transition of Hopf-link braids and the associated rich exceptional phase portraits may offer new physical insights with promising applications in robust, fault-tolerant communication channels and quantum computing platforms.

TL;DR: 该论文研究了受控量子隐形传态中控制器测量对保真度及其偏差的影响，发现控制器的辅助不会降低最小保真度偏差，尤其是在W类纯态中，揭示了控制对保真度和保真度偏差的对比效应。
摘要翻译

隐形传态的性能通常通过平均隐形传态保真度来表征，而其随输入态的变化则提供了由保真度偏差捕捉的额外信息。在受控隐形传态中，控制者的测量通过其测量结果引入了保真度变化的额外来源。我们研究了使用三比特纯态的受控隐形传态中的保真度偏差。我们推导出保真度偏差的一个下界，并表明该下界与最大平均隐形传态保真度可同时达到。然而，在达到最大平均保真度的各个测量中，保真度偏差可能因控制者的测量不同而有所变化。我们进一步通过对比使用约化态的直接隐形传态，检验了控制者辅助的效果。与最大平均保真度不同，其不会因控制者辅助而降低，而最小保真度偏差却未必因控制者辅助而减少。尤为值得注意的是，对于任何W类纯态，控制者辅助都无法降低保真度偏差。这些结果揭示了受控隐形传态中，控制对隐形传态保真度及其偏差所产生的不同影响。

Abstract

Teleportation performance is commonly characterized by the average teleportation fidelity, while its variation over input states provides additional information captured by the fidelity deviation. In controlled teleportation, the controller's measurement introduces an additional source of fidelity variation through its measurement outcomes. We investigate the fidelity deviation in controlled teleportation with three-qubit pure states. We derive a lower bound on the fidelity deviation and show that it is attainable together with the maximal average teleportation fidelity. Among the measurements attaining the maximal average fidelity, however, the fidelity deviation can vary depending on the controller's measurement. We further examine the effect of controller assistance by comparing controlled teleportation with direct teleportation using the reduced state. Unlike the maximal average fidelity, which cannot decrease with controller assistance, the minimal fidelity deviation is not necessarily reduced by controller assistance. In particular, for any W-class pure state, controller assistance cannot reduce the fidelity deviation. These results reveal contrasting effects of control on teleportation fidelity and its deviation in controlled teleportation.

TL;DR: 本文数值研究了用弱耦合fluxonium量子比特控制单模谐振器中的ECD门，证明在比特翻转保护下保真度可超99.9%，并通过半经典方法揭示了强驱动下色散位移的饱和效应，提出了改进的ECD序列。
摘要翻译

回波条件位移（ECD）门是对谐振子模式进行量子控制的基本构建模块。然而，辅助量子比特的比特翻转仍然是这类玻色子控制中的主要误差机制。在本工作中，我们对一个受比特翻转保护的磁通量子比特作为控制量子比特进行了数值案例研究，并在单模谐振器-磁通量子比特器件中数值实现了ECD门，证明保真度可超过99.9%。我们结合半经典轨迹和主方程模拟系统研究了谐振器动力学，数值上揭示了在谐振器强驱动区域色散位移的渐近饱和现象。我们开发了一种高效技术，利用半经典公式对谐振器的强驱动区域进行数值模拟，该公式将色散展开中的完整微扰级数映射为逐阶频移。这为谐振器提供了一个紧凑的多项式描述，该描述直观且在整个色散区域内保持有效。此外，我们提出了一种改进的ECD序列，该序列考虑了光子损耗和杂散非线性项对谐振器轨迹的影响。

Abstract

Echoed Conditional Displacement (ECD) gates constitute a fundamental building block for quantum control of harmonic oscillator modes. However, bit-flips of the auxiliary qubit remain a dominant error mechanism for this kind of bosonic control. In this work, we present a numerical case study of a bit-flip protected fluxonium operating as the control qubit and numerically implement ECD gates in a single-mode resonator-fluxonium device, demonstrating that fidelities exceeding 99.9% are possible. We systematically investigate the resonator dynamics using a combination of semiclassical trajectories and master equation simulations, numerically revealing asymptotic saturation of the dispersive shift in the strongly driven regime of the resonator. We develop an efficient technique to numerically simulate the strongly driven regime of the resonator using a semiclassical formulation that maps the full perturbation series in the dispersive expansion as order-by-order frequency shifts. This provides a compact polynomial description of the resonator which is intuitive and remains valid throughout the dispersive regime. Furthermore, we propose an improved ECD sequence that accounts for the effects of photon loss and spurious nonlinear terms on resonator trajectories.

TL;DR: The paper introduces a dynamical parameter-space representation for QAOA and shows that near-optimal gradient regions occupy a distinct intermediate regime that remains accessible in these variables across circuit sizes, unlike the compressed native angle parameterization.
摘要翻译

表征量子近似优化算法（QAOA）的可训练性，需要理解其梯度景观如何随电路参数和问题规模变化。然而，这些梯度通常以QAOA原生角度来描述，使我们难以将参数特有的特征与底层电路动力学的更广泛变化区分开来。在此，我们引入一种基于范数加权层强度和成本-混合器不平衡的QAOA参数空间动力学表示，将演化的整体尺度与两个生成器的相对贡献分离开来。 通过对MaxCut的精确态模拟，我们发现梯度景观在这些动力学变量中展现出一种粗粒度组织，该组织在电路深度和调度结构的变化中持续存在，而更精细的干涉图样仍依赖于具体调度。近优解并非简单地与最大局部梯度重合，而是占据一个不同的中间动力学区域。均匀调度恢复该区域的大致位置，而非均匀调度主要重组其精细结构。在所研究的系统尺寸范围内，近优解区域在动力学表示中保持扩展，而它们在QAOA原生角度中的原像在较大尺寸下则变得显著压缩。这些结果将有用QAOA动力学的持续性与其在原生参数化中的可达性区分开来，并为跨电路和问题尺度解释QAOA可训练性提供了动力学框架。

Abstract

Characterizing the trainability of the Quantum Approximate Optimization Algorithm (QAOA) requires understanding how its gradient landscape changes across circuit parameters and problem size. Yet these gradients are usually described in terms of the native QAOA angles, making it difficult to distinguish parameter specific features from broader changes in the underlying circuit dynamics. Here we introduce a dynamical representation of the QAOA parameter space based on a norm-weighted layer strength and a cost--mixer imbalance, separating the overall scale of the evolution from the relative contribution of the two generators. Using exact-state simulations of MaxCut, we find that the gradient landscape exhibits a coarse organization in these dynamical variables that persists across changes in circuit depth and schedule structure, while the finer interference pattern remains schedule dependent. Near-optimal solutions do not simply coincide with the largest local gradients, but instead occupy a distinct intermediate dynamical regime. Uniform schedules recover the broad location of this regime, whereas nonuniform schedules mainly reorganize its fine structure. Across the system sizes studied, near-optimal solution regions remain extended in the dynamical representation while their preimages in the native QAOA angles become substantially compressed at larger sizes. These results separate the persistence of useful QAOA dynamics from their accessibility in the native parameterization, and provide a dynamical framework for interpreting QAOA trainability across circuit and problem scales.

摘要翻译

协变量子Fisher信息（CQFI）最近已被确立为赝厄米传感器的终极精度基准[Phys. Rev. Lett. 136, 080802 (2026)]，然而现有分析仅限于单模系统。本文将CQFI形式推广至多模非厄米Su-Schrieffer-Heeger（SSH）晶格，并揭示了由非厄米趋肤效应（NHSE）实现的可调拓扑增强。在开放边界条件下，NHSE将常规布里渊区形变为半径为r = exp(κ)的广义布里渊区，其中κ为非布洛赫衰减率。虽然总CQFI随系统尺寸N线性标度，但其前因子关键地取决于κ，由此产生增强因子E(N) = F_OBC/F_PBC，在N ~ 30时超过30，显著优于周期边界传感器。该增强对中等局域无序具有鲁棒性，并支持多参数估计，联合Cramér-Rao界最多可降低15个数量级。这些发现确立了量子计量学的空间域机制，补充了时域策略，并可通过现有技术下的拓扑电路、光子晶格和超导电路在实验上实现。

Abstract

The covariant quantum Fisher information (CQFI) has recently been established as the ultimate precision benchmark for pseudo-Hermitian sensors [Phys. Rev. Lett. 136, 080802 (2026)], yet existing analyses are limited to single-mode systems. Here we extend the CQFI formalism to multi-mode non-Hermitian Su-Schrieffer-Heeger lattices and reveal tunable topological enhancement enabled by the non-Hermitian skin effect (NHSE). Under open boundary conditions, the NHSE deforms the conventional Brillouin zone into a generalized Brillouin zone of radius r = exp(\k{appa}), where \k{appa} denotes the non-Bloch decay rate. While the total CQFI scales linearly with system size N, its prefactor depends critically on \k{appa}, yielding an enhancement factor E(N) = F_OBC / F_PBC that exceeds 30 for N ~ 30, substantially outperforming periodic-boundary sensors. The enhancement is robust against moderate local disorder and supports multi-parameter estimation, with the joint Cramér-Rao bound reduced by up to 15 orders of magnitude. These findings establish a spatial-domain mechanism for quantum metrology that complements time-domain strategies and is experimentally accessible using topoelectrical circuits, photonic lattices, and superconducting circuits with current technology.

在本工作中，我们将散射量子游走（scattering quantum walk, SQW）框架扩展到由能量依赖的点相互作用构成的晶格上。这便在硬币量子游走（coined quantum walk, CQW）形式中产生了一个与零程势散射矩阵直接相关的硬币算子。该模型从而提供了Kronig-Penney型点相互作用周期阵列的离散时间量子游走（discrete-time quantum-walk, DTQW）模拟，其中游走者的波数作为连续且物理透明的控制参数来操控硬币操作。我们分析了位置概率与纠缠的谱和动力学，针对特定能量和点相互作用得到了不同的结果。我们将谱结构与空间概率分布联系起来，并明确刻画了每种点相互作用下的长时间纠缠行为。透射模决定了准能隙、带宽和最大群速度，同时也控制了所考虑初态下的长时间硬币-位置纠缠。四类一维点相互作用（$δ$、$δ'$、交叉型和非对称型）实现了性质不同的透射轮廓，并涵盖了全部行为范围，包括增强或强烈抑制的扩展行为以及振荡型纠缠。

Abstract

In this work, we extend the scattering quantum walk (SQW) framework to a lattice of energy-dependent point interactions. This yields, within the coined quantum walk (CQW) formalism, a coin operator that is directly related to the scattering matrix of zero-range potentials. The model thus provides a discrete-time quantum-walk (DTQW) analog of a periodic array of point interactions of the Kronig-Penney type, where the walker's wavenumber serves as a continuous, physically transparent control parameter for the coin operation. We analyze the spectra and the dynamics of position probability and entanglement, yielding distinct results for specific energies and point interactions. We relate the spectral structure to the spatial probability distribution and explicitly characterize the long-time entanglement behavior for each point interaction. The transmission modulus determines the quasienergy gap, bandwidth, and maximum group velocity, while also controlling the long-time coin-position entanglement for the initial state considered. The four families of one-dimensional point interactions ($δ$, $δ'$, crossed and asymmetric) realize qualitatively distinct transmission profiles and span the full range of behavior, including enhanced or strongly suppressed spreading and oscillatory entanglement.

TL;DR: 本文系统地刻画了量子计算中k=1编码情形下的完美逻辑融合策略，证明随机图码几乎必然存在完美融合策略，并首次为量子奇偶校验码构造出此类策略。
摘要翻译

逻辑融合（logical fusion）在量子信息的许多任务中，如量子纠错和量子中继器中，具有重要作用。在光子体系中，我们必须面对这样一个事实：物理融合（physical fusion）是概率性的（即相关量子比特是在乘积基下被测量的），而这根据失败模式及相应的基，可能导致逻辑层面上的失败。每个量子比特的失败基的选择称为融合策略（fusion strategy），寻找良好的融合策略对于优化基于融合的量子计算（fusion-based quantum computation）的性能至关重要。本文给出了当编码 \(k=1\) 个量子比特时的完备刻画，特别地刻画了这样一类码和融合策略：除一个物理融合之外，其余物理融合都可以失败，即完美融合策略（perfect fusion strategy）。借此，我们重新得到了先前已知的完美融合策略，并为量子奇偶校验码（quantum parity-check code）找到了完美融合策略，回答了一个开放问题。我们还进一步证明了完美融合策略具有普遍性（generic）：随机 \([[n,1,d]]\) 图码（graph code）以指数上接近 1 的概率拥有完美融合策略。此外，我们还通过为一种新的图参数给出一种新的、具有操作意义的解释，为该参数的研究提供了动机；该图参数定义为：对图中一个给定顶点，取遍所有LC等价（LC-equivalent）图时该顶点处度数的最大值。

Abstract

Logical fusions are important for a number of tasks in quantum information, such as quantum error correction and quantum repeaters. In the photonic setting one must contend with the fact that physical fusions are probabilistic (i.e.~the associated qubits are measured in product bases), which---depending on the failures and the associated bases---can lead to a failure on the logical level. The choice of failure basis of each qubit is known as a fusion strategy, and finding good fusion strategies is important for optimizing performance of fusion-based quantum computation. Here we provide a complete characterization when $k=1$ qubits are encoded, and in particular characterize those codes and fusion strategies such that all but one physical fusion can fail, i.e.~\emph{perfect fusion strategies}. In doing so, we recover previously known perfect fusion strategies, and find perfect fusion strategies for quantum parity-check codes, answering an open question. We furthermore show that perfect fusion strategies are generic: random $[[n, 1, d]]$ graph codes admit a perfect fusion strategy with probability exponentially close to $1$. Additionally we motivate the study of a new graph parameter, namely the maximum degree of a graph at a given vertex taken over all LC-equivalent graphs, by giving a new operationally meaningful interpretation of it.

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于变分量子特征求解器（VQE）的割平面框架来求解半定规划问题，通过量子资源替代经典特征分解步骤，实验表明在SDPLIB问题上能闭合大部分最优性间隙，并揭示了实际实现中的若干关键效应。
摘要翻译

半定规划在优化中扮演着关键角色，对控制理论、机器学习和组合优化具有广泛影响。尽管半定规划在多项式时间内可解，但几种常用算法依赖于一个线性代数步骤，其运行时间随矩阵维度呈三次方增长，并且该步骤要求矩阵本身存储在内存中，代价为二次方。在本研究中，我们提出用变分量子特征求解器替代该步骤，其对量子比特的需求随矩阵维度呈对数增长，并首次给出了这种方案在割平面框架内的端到端实现，同时提出了一种从算子导出的拟设，其纠缠结构直接从候选矩阵的泡利支撑中读取。在与使用精确特征分解的相同方案进行对比评估中（基于SDPLIB控制问题族），变分预言机在全程产生有效割，闭合了初始最优性间隙的32%至82%，而精确预言机则接近恒定地闭合75%至82%。端到端实现并测量该方法，揭示了仅凭理论分析无法观察到的若干效应：内存实际消耗在何处，将矩阵填充到量子寄存器所需的填充如何可能误导变分优化器，以及为何候选矩阵在泡利基下表现为稠密，从而使算子导出的拟设退化为完全纠缠。我们报告了这些发现，并讨论了它们对近期混合量子-经典方法的影响。

Abstract

Semidefinite programming plays a key role in optimization, with broad impact across control theory, machine learning, and combinatorial optimization. Although semidefinite programs are polynomially solvable, several commonly used algorithms rest on a linear-algebraic step whose running time grows cubically with the matrix dimension and which requires the matrix itself to be held in memory, at quadratic cost. In this study, we propose replacing it with a variational quantum eigensolver, whose qubit requirement is logarithmic in the matrix dimension, and present the first end-to-end implementation of such an approach within a cutting-plane framework, together with an operator-derived ansatz whose entanglement structure is read directly from the Pauli support of the candidate matrix. Evaluated on the control family of SDPLIB against an identical scheme driven by an exact eigendecomposition, the variational oracle produces valid cuts throughout, closing 32 to 82% of the initial optimality gap against a near-constant 75 to 82% for the exact oracle. Implementing and measuring the method end to end surfaces several effects not visible from theoretical analyses alone: where memory is actually consumed, how the padding required to fit a matrix onto a quantum register can mislead the variational optimizer, and why the candidate matrices prove dense in the Pauli basis, reducing the operator-derived ansatz to full entanglement. We report these findings and discuss their implications for near-term hybrid quantum-classical approaches.

摘要翻译

本研究探讨了扩展的非互易量子电池的性能，以及相较于互易充电和原有非互易电池，其在能量存储与能量转移方面的优势。在分析了充电系统与外部泵之间的失谐后，我们发现共振是维持高能量电池和高充电功率的关键因素；此外，充电器或电池的失谐决定了不同结构充电过程的稳定性。对电池稳态能量存储的研究揭示，在弱局域化环境中，单线程或多线程充电能够实现近乎无限的能量存储，从而展示了扩展非互易量子电池显著的能量优势。最后，通过考虑充电系统内的能量分布，我们观察到非互易充电提供了互易充电无法比拟的能量转移优势；前者实现了充电成本与能量存储能力之间的综合平衡，这是后者无法企及的。作为一种新颖且优越的充电协议，我们的发现有望为非互易充电的推广和实际应用提供有力的参考。

Abstract

This study investigates the performance of extended nonreciprocal quantum batteries (QBs), as well as its advantages in energy storage and energy transfer compared to reciprocal charging and the original nonreciprocal batteries. After analyzing the detuning between the charging system and the external pump, we discover that resonance is a key factor in maintaining high-energy batteries and high charging power; furthermore, the detuning of the charger or battery determines the stability of the charging process for different structures. Research on steady-state energy storage in batteries revealed that single-threaded or multi-threaded charging can achieve nearly infinite energy storage in weakly localized environments, thereby demonstrating the significant energy advantages of extended nonreciprocal quantum batteries. Finally, by considering the energy distribution within the charging system, we observe that nonreciprocal charging offers energy transfer advantages unmatched by reciprocal charging; the former achieves a comprehensive balance between charging cost and energy storage capacity that the latter cannot match. As a novel and superior charging protocol, our findings are expected to provide a potent reference for the promotion and practical implementation of nonreciprocal charging.

TL;DR: 本文提出了Quantum MeanFlow，一种在NISQ硬件上通过学习平均速度场实现单步生成的量子生成模型，解决了量子流匹配需要多步顺序电路提交的问题，并在MNIST数据集上展示了优于单步QFM的采样性能，同时通过best-of-N拒绝采样缓解了设备噪声的影响。
摘要翻译

量子生成模型为探索量子计算能否增强生成式机器学习提供了一个有前景的框架。流匹配是一种生成方法，通过学到的速度场将简单的已知分布传输到目标数据分布来生成样本。其量子对应物，称为量子流匹配（QFM），最近被提出，并且与其经典对应物类似，在推理过程中需要在许多时间步上对常微分方程进行积分。由于每一步都需要前一步的输出，电路提交是顺序进行的，这在具有高输入/输出成本的量子计算机上是一个缺点。为了缓解这一问题，我们引入了量子平均流（Quantum MeanFlow, QMF），即MeanFlow公式的量子类比，它允许单步样本生成。QFM在每一步学习瞬时速度场，而QMF学习时间间隔上的平均速度。我们使用参数化量子电路来学习这些速度场，并在MNIST数据集上对两种方法进行基准测试。我们表明，虽然单步QMF的图像质量低于多步QFM，但在每个射击次数下，它的表现都优于单步QFM采样。我们的两个模型都在IBM量子计算机上执行，并且最佳N拒绝采样在不修改电路的情况下恢复了大部分因设备噪声而损失的精度。这对QMF尤为有利，因为每个图像只需一次电路评估。在此，我们将QMF确立为一种可行的单步量子生成采样方法，减少了每个生成样本的量子电路评估次数。

Abstract

Quantum generative models offer a promising framework for exploring whether quantum computation can enhance generative machine learning. Flow matching is a generative method in which samples are generated by transporting a simple, known distribution to the target data distribution with a learned velocity field. Its quantum counterpart, known as quantum flow matching (QFM), was introduced recently, and, like its classical counterpart, requires integrating an ordinary differential equation over many time steps during inference. As each step requires the output from the previous step, the circuit submission is sequential and a drawback on quantum computers as they have high input/output costs. To alleviate this problem, we introduce Quantum MeanFlow (QMF), the quantum analogue of the MeanFlow formulation, which allows single-step sample generation. While the QFM learns an instantaneous velocity field at each time step, QMF learns the average velocity over a time interval. We use a parameterized quantum circuit to learn these velocity fields and benchmark the two methods on the MNIST dataset. We show that while single-step QMF has lower image quality compared to multi-step QFM, it performs better than the single-step QFM sampling at every shot count. Both of our models are executed on IBM quantum computers and best-of-N rejection sampling recovers most of the accuracy lost to device noise without modifying the circuit. This is especially advantageous for QMF which has only one circuit evaluation per image. Here, We establish QMF as a viable method for single-step quantum generative sampling, saving on quantum circuit evaluations per generated sample.

TL;DR: The paper proves that using high-rank encoders (which produce mixed code states) can improve the optimal entanglement fidelity in approximate quantum error correction, even allowing near-perfect recovery in certain noise regimes, while every optimal encoder necessarily outputs mixed states for this noise family.
摘要翻译

常规的量子码（quantum-code）构造将纯逻辑态（pure logical states）编码为纯码态（pure code states），但这种限制可能牺牲性能。我们表明，固有的编码随机性（encoding randomness）能够提高最优纠缠保真度（entanglement fidelity）。我们给出了强制采用秩一编码器（rank-one encoder）所造成损失的界，并证明在联合优化（joint optimization）之后、接近完美恢复（perfect recovery）时，该损失至多为二次量级。这一优化后的优势在小噪声扰动（noise perturbations）下仍然存在。一个显式的噪声族（noise family）要求使用更高秩编码器（higher-rank encoders）才能任意接近完美恢复，且每个最优编码器都将纯输入态（pure inputs）映射为混合码态（mixed code states）。

Abstract

Conventional quantum-code constructions encode pure logical states as pure code states, but this restriction can sacrifice performance. We show that intrinsic encoding randomness can improve optimal entanglement fidelity. We bound the loss from imposing a rank-one encoder and prove it is at most quadratic near perfect recovery after joint optimization. The optimized advantage survives small noise perturbations. An explicit noise family requires higher-rank encoders arbitrarily close to perfect recovery, with every optimal encoder mapping pure inputs to mixed code states.

TL;DR: 该论文研究二维整数格点上具有两两接触相互作用的三玻色子薛定谔算子，在强耦合极限下推导了束缚态能量的精确渐近、指数局域化衰减率上界及谱隙估计，并指出这些结果对光晶格中少玻色子系统量子模拟的潜在意义。
摘要翻译

我们研究二维整数格上具有两两接触相互作用的三玻色子薛定谔算子。首先，在强耦合极限 μ→∞ 下，我们得到了零总准动量处本质谱下方两个束缚态的精确渐近：基态能量为 −3μ+6+O(1/μ)，第一激发态能量为 −μ+C+O(1/μ)，其中 C=4−δ≈3.96458，δ 由涉及晶格格林函数的超越方程 b0(δ)=1/(1+δ) 确定。相应的谱隙为 2μ+O(1)。其次，利用离散 Agmon 比较方法和 Paley-Wiener 定理，我们建立了基态波函数的指数局域化，其衰减率 α(μ) 具有至多 ln(3μ)+O(1/μ) 的对数上界，这反映了晶格色散的有界性；精确的渐近速率仍属猜想。第三，在准动量 π 处，宇称对称性保持不变，但奇二次型变为正定，具有一个阶为 1/μ 的唯一特征值，该特征值永不达到 Birman-Schwinger 阈值，因此奇子空间仅产生一个虚能级。偶子空间恰好支持一个束缚态，其能量为 −2μ+6+8/μ+O(1/μ²)，与本质谱之间的谱隙为 μ−2−8/μ+O(1/μ²)。从零准动量处的两个束缚态减少为 π 处的一个束缚态，保持了总谱流，这是一种晶格特有现象。我们的方法运用 Birman-Schwinger 算子的不变子空间分解以及 Krein-Rutman 定理，以保证基态的唯一性和严格正性。这些结果对光晶格中少玻色子系统的量子模拟具有直接意义。

Abstract

We study the three-boson Schrodinger operator on the two-dimensional integer lattice with pairwise contact interactions. First, we obtain precise asymptotics of the two bound states below the essential spectrum at zero total quasimomentum in the strong-coupling limit mu to infinity: the ground state energy is -3 mu + 6 + O(1/mu), and the first excited state energy is - mu + C + O(1/mu), where C = 4 - delta approximately 3.96458, with delta determined by the transcendental equation b0(delta) = 1/(1+delta) involving the lattice Green's function. The associated spectral gap is 2 mu + O(1). Second, using the discrete Agmon comparison method and the Paley-Wiener theorem, we establish exponential localization of the ground-state wavefunction with a logarithmic upper bound on the decay rate alpha(mu) at most ln(3 mu) + O(1/mu), reflecting the bounded nature of the lattice dispersion; the sharp asymptotic rate is conjectured. Third, at quasimomentum pi, the parity symmetry is preserved, but the odd quadratic form becomes positive definite with a unique eigenvalue of order 1/mu that never reaches the Birman-Schwinger threshold, so the odd subspace yields only a virtual level. The even subspace supports exactly one bound state with energy -2 mu + 6 + 8/mu + O(1/mu^2), and the spectral gap to the essential spectrum is mu - 2 - 8/mu + O(1/mu^2). The reduction from two bound states at zero to one at pi preserves the total spectral flow and is a lattice-specific phenomenon. Our approach uses an invariant subspace decomposition of the Birman-Schwinger operator and the Krein-Rutman theorem to guarantee uniqueness and strict positivity of the ground state. These results have direct implications for quantum simulation of few-boson systems in optical lattices.

TL;DR: 论文研究量子信息的局部化度量，证明了一种源自非交换几何的调整后von Neumann熵是量化局部化信息的最小且唯一的量子熵，并能以冗余信息表征Bell态从而推广经典情形，适用范围为有限维C*-代数模型。
摘要翻译

信息可以被局域化的观念在物理学中无处不在。在热力学中，熵从一个热库流向另一个热库；在量子引力中，某些空间区域的熵含量是有界的。在量子信息理论中，信息从一个地方传输到另一个地方，而当这种传输受到约束时，纠缠可以提供优势。 香农熵（Shannon entropy）以边际化定义了经典多体系统各部分集合上的外测度，从而量化了可局域化信息。相比之下，冯·诺依曼熵（von Neumann entropy）并不能以此方式量化可局域化信息。然而，一种源于非交换几何的冯·诺依曼熵变体确实可以做到这一点。 我们证明了这一修正后的冯·诺依曼熵是量化可局域化信息的最小量子熵。我们还证明了，它是唯一能够以冗余信息来刻画贝尔态（Bell states）的量子熵，从而直接推广了经典情形。我们全程使用有限维$C^*$-代数，用以建模可能具有超选择扇区的有限量子系统。

Abstract

The idea that information can be localized is pervasive in physics. In thermodynamics, entropy flows from one reservoir to another, and in quantum gravity, the entropy content of some spatial regions is bounded. In quantum information theory, information is transmitted from one place to another, and entanglement can provide an advantage when there are constraints on such transmission. Shannon entropy quantifies localizable information in the sense that marginalization defines an outer measure on the set of parts of a classical multipartite system. In contrast, von Neumann entropy does not quantify localizable information in this sense. However, a variant of von Neumann entropy, which originates in noncommutative geometry, does. We prove that this adjusted von Neumann entropy is the minimum quantum entropy that quantifies localizable information. We also prove that this is the unique quantum entropy that characterizes Bell states in terms of redundant information, directly generalizing the classical case. We work with finite-dimensional $C^*$-algebras throughout, modeling finite quantum systems that may have superselection sectors.

62. GadIR: A Spatial-Topology Preserving Compiler for Quantum Many-Body Systems Simulation PASS
Score: 10.0 / 3.0
Authors: Xiangyu Ren, Yuexun Huang, Zhaohui Yang, Yuchen Zhu, Tsung-Wei Huang, Tsung-Yi Ho, Zhiding Liang, Antonio Barbalace
Published: 2026-09-01

TL;DR: 提出GadIR，一种利用Pauli gadgets保留空间拓扑信息的量子多体系统模拟编译器，通过前端组约化和后端trotter化与调度，显著降低经典多体哈密顿量在多种量子架构上的编译开销。
摘要翻译

模拟量子多体系统一直是量子计算最重要的应用之一。为了进行模拟，物理系统的哈密顿量被编译为量子程序，使用量子硬件的原生指令。在以往的工作中，哈密顿量被表示为泡利字符串，然后基于量子电路模型进行编译和优化。这种表示范式忽略了原始物理模型的空间拓扑结构，而该结构对于减少多体系统哈密顿量编译开销至关重要。为解决这一忽视，我们引入了一种面向量子多体模拟的空间拓扑保持编译器。使用泡利小工具（Pauli gadgets）作为哈密顿量的表示，我们提出了中间表示——GadIR，以保留原始物理模型的空间拓扑信息。我们编译器的前端执行基于泡利小工具模型的群归约算法，这是一种与硬件无关的优化。编译器后端对泡利小工具执行特罗特化（trotterization）与调度，然后将泡利小工具合成为硬件原生的量子程序。我们在所有典型量子多体系统模型上评估了该编译器，在四种主要量子架构下均实现了编译开销的显著降低。总体而言，我们提出的空间拓扑保持中间表示为量子多体系统哈密顿量的编译优化开辟了新的空间。

Abstract

Simulating quantum many-body systems has been one of the most important applications of quantum computation. For simulation, the Hamiltonian of a physical system is compiled into quantum programs with native instructions for quantum hardware. In previous works, the Hamiltonian is represented as Pauli strings, then compiled and optimized based on the quantum circuit model. Such representation paradigm neglects the spatial topology of original physical models, which is vital information to reducing the overhead of compiling many-body systems Hamiltonians. To address such neglect, we introduce a spatial-topology preserving compiler for quantum many-body simulation. Using Pauli gadgets as the representations of the Hamiltonian, we introduce our intermediate representation -- GadIR, to preserve the spatial-topology information of original physical models. Our compiler frontend performs the group reduction algorithm based on Pauli gadget model, which is a hardware-independent optimization. Our compiler backend performs trotterization and scheduling on Pauli gadgets, then synthesizes the Pauli gadgets into hardware-native quantum programs. We evaluate our compiler on all the canonical quantum many-body system models, while achieving a significant reduction on compilation overhead regarding four major quantum architectures. Overall, our spatial-topology preserving IR exploits the compilation optimization space for quantum many-body systems Hamiltonian.

TL;DR: 该论文提出了一种基于量子Fisher信息度量的信息几何框架，将后淬灭参数和实时间作为坐标构造扩展信息流形，用于刻画非平衡量子态，并分析了几何可观测量与纠缠熵和Loschmidt回波之间的关联。
摘要翻译

我们讨论了一个用于表征非平衡动力学中量子态的信息几何框架。以横向场伊辛链模型作为实验平台，我们研究了量子Fisher信息度量，特别关注混合度量分量$g_{ht}$及相关几何可观测量，其中$h$是可控的淬火后哈密顿参数，$t$是实时时间。该框架将$h$和$t$视为扩展信息流形$(h,t)$的坐标。几何可观测量表征了流形上演化的速度以及时间方向与参数形变方向之间的对齐程度。我们分析了这些几何量与两个广泛使用的非平衡动力学度量——纠缠熵和Loschmidt回声——之间的相关性。

Abstract

We discuss an information-geometric framework for characterizing quantum states in non-equilibrium dynamics. Using the transverse-field Ising chain model as a laboratory, we investigate the quantum Fisher information metric with particular emphasis on the mixed metric component $g_{ht}$ and related geometric observables, where $h$ is a controllable post-quench Hamiltonian parameter and $t$ is real time. The framework treats $h$ and $t$ as coordinates of an extended information manifold $(h,t)$. The geometric observables characterize the speed of evolution on the manifold and the alignment between the temporal and parameter-deformation directions. Correlations between these geometric quantities and two widely used measures of non-equilibrium dynamics, the entanglement entropy and the Loschmidt echo, are analyzed.

64. Shuttling-aware dynamical decoupling for quantum charge-coupled devices PASS
Score: 9.0 / 3.0
Authors: Linus Schulte, Aaron Sander, Robert Wille
Published: 2026-09-02
Version: v1
TL;DR: 该论文提出了一种对输运敏感的动力学解耦（SADD）编译方法，通过联合优化离子重路由和重聚焦脉冲，在保持逻辑门时序和总调度长度不变的前提下，显著提高了量子电荷耦合器件在退相干噪声占优情况下的保真度。
摘要翻译

动力学解耦（DD）通过精心定时的重聚焦脉冲抑制退相位噪声，从而有助于维持高保真度的量子计算。然而，在量子电荷耦合器件（QCCD）架构中，离子在整个器件内穿梭，输运过程会限制脉冲的施加时机，并影响离子累积的相位。传统DD方法未考虑穿梭因素，因此可能在输运调度后不得不省略或移位原计划中的脉冲，从而削弱了对退相位的抑制。为此，我们提出穿梭感知的动力学解耦（SADD），这是一种离线的编译器过程，在保持逻辑门时序和总调度长度的同时，联合选择重聚焦脉冲与局部离子重路由。基准模拟表明，当退相位主导控制与输运误差、且其变化足够缓慢以适用DD时，SADD的平均最终态保真度既高于原始调度，也高于一种简单的最近可行Hahn-echo基线。重路由使原本不可行的脉冲时序成为可能，而噪声的空间信息还能带来进一步增益。然而，当新增输运引入过大误差时，这些优势便消失。总体而言，我们的结果表明，将DD与离子输运相协调是QCCD处理器中降低退相位的一种有效编译策略。

Abstract

Dynamical decoupling (DD) helps maintain high-fidelity quantum computations by suppressing dephasing noise through carefully timed refocusing pulses. In quantum charge-coupled device (QCCD) architectures, however, where ions are shuttled throughout the device, transport constrains when pulses can be applied and affects the phase accumulated by an ion. Conventional DD methods do not account for shuttling and may therefore schedule pulses that must be omitted or shifted after transport scheduling, weakening the protection from dephasing. We therefore introduce shuttling-aware dynamical decoupling (SADD), an offline compiler pass that jointly selects refocusing pulses and local ion rerouting while preserving logical-gate timings and the total schedule length. In benchmark simulations, SADD improves average final-state fidelity over both the original schedules and a simple nearest-feasible Hahn-echo baseline when dephasing dominates control and transport errors and varies slowly enough for DD. Rerouting enables otherwise infeasible pulse timings, while spatial information about the noise can provide further gains. These benefits disappear, however, when the added transport introduces too much error. Overall, our results show that coordinating DD with ion transport is an effective compiler strategy for reducing dephasing in QCCD processors.

摘要翻译

多量子比特架构的精确控制仍是超导量子处理器中的关键瓶颈。在本工作中，我们研究了从三到七个位点扩展的超导线性链中高保真量子操作与态传输协议的合成。利用Floquet理论，我们将周期性驱动建模为一系列δ型脉冲，将量子控制问题映射到准能量共振条件上。结合Baker-Campbell-Hausdorff展开与Floquet谱分解，我们解析地识别出最优驱动参数，并通过协方差矩阵自适应进化策略（CMA-ES）进行优化。在三量子比特架构中，这实现了iSWAP门的高保真合成。扩展到七位点链后，我们实施有限宽度高斯脉冲的周期序列，以激活具有超短门时长t_gate（约170 ns）的不同双激发输运通道。这实现了与典型固定频率transmon器件（带可调耦合器，如IBM Quantum硬件）的能量弛豫时间（T1）的清晰尺度分离。最后，我们基准测试了在现实非理想条件下的稳定性，揭示了由谱拥挤引起的对亚百分位水平（η~10^-3）静态参数无序的增强敏感性，并讨论了闭环拓扑如何缓解这一约束。该框架桥接了时间周期控制理论与实际量子门工程。

Abstract

Precise control of multi-qubit architectures remains a critical bottleneck in superconducting quantum processors. In this work, we investigate the synthesis of high-fidelity quantum operations and state transfer protocols within an extended superconducting linear chain, scaling from three to seven sites. Using Floquet theory, we model the periodic drive as a train of delta-like pulses, mapping the quantum control problem onto quasi-energy resonance conditions. Combining the Baker-Campbell-Hausdorff expansion with Floquet spectral decomposition, we analytically identify optimal driving parameters, refined via the Covariance Matrix Adaptation Evolution Strategy (CMA-ES). In the three-qubit architecture, this enables high-fidelity synthesis of the iSWAP gate. Extending to a seven-site chain, we implement periodic trains of finite-width Gaussian pulses to activate distinct double-excitation transport channels with ultra-short gate durations t_gate (~170 ns). This achieves a clear scale separation from energy-relaxation times (T1) typical of fixed-frequency transmon devices with tunable couplers, such as IBM Quantum hardware. Finally, we benchmark stability under realistic imperfections, revealing a heightened sensitivity to static parameter disorder at the sub-percent level (eta ~ 10^-3) driven by spectral crowding, and discuss how closed-loop topologies could mitigate this constraint. This framework bridges time-periodic control theory and practical quantum gate engineering.

摘要翻译

高保真度CZ门是超导量子处理器的核心，但基于磁通调谐的实现仍对脉冲失真敏感。通常用于孤立门的传统预失真虽能恢复芯片上的期望磁通，但在存在磁通线记忆时会失效，导致重复执行的CZ门保真度迅速下降。为解决这一问题，我们将磁通线失真建模为有状态经典执行器与量子系统耦合的动力学过程。利用一阶Dyson展开，推导了由初始磁通线状态变化引起的误差生成器。随后，通过优化磁通脉冲来抑制这些误差生成器，并最小化门出口处的残余磁通线状态，设计出鲁棒的CZ门。单极点磁通线模型呈现了预期的一阶鲁棒平台。对于更接近实际的三极点模型，优化后的CZ脉冲实现了平均保真度F_avg=99.998%，抑制了全部一阶误差生成器，并将残余磁通线状态降至接近零。在门间无需额外等待时间的条件下，鲁棒脉冲使完整十门序列的平均保真度达到F_avg=99.97%；与同一预失真协议下的基线相比，序列不保真度降至基线的约1/(2.3×10^3)。这些结果表明，显式考虑磁通线记忆能够在重复门序列中维持高保真CZ操作，并解决了传统预失真方法的一项关键局限。

Abstract

High-fidelity CZ gates are central to superconducting quantum processors, but implementations based on flux tuning are still sensitive to pulse distortion. Conventional predistortion, typically used for an isolated gate, can recover the desired flux at the chip but it fails if the flux line memory exists, causing the fidelity of repeated CZ gates to drop rapidly. To address this issue, we model the flux line distortion as the dynamics of a stateful classical actuator coupled to a quantum system. Using a first-order Dyson expansion, we derive the error generators induced by variations in the initial flux-line state. We then design a robust CZ gate by optimizing the flux pulse to suppress these generators and minimize the residual flux line state at the gate exit. A one-pole flux line model shows the expected first-order robustness plateau. For a more practical three-pole model, the optimized CZ pulse achieves $F_{\mathrm{avg}}=99.998\%$, suppresses all first-order error generators, and brings the residual flux line state close to zero. With no additional waiting time between gates, our robust pulse achieves $F_{\mathrm{avg}}=99.97\%$ for the complete ten-gate sequence and reduces the sequence infidelity by a factor of about $2.3\times10^{3}$ relative to the baseline under the same predistortion protocol. These results show that explicitly accounting for flux line memory maintains high-fidelity CZ operation across repeated gate sequences and addresses a key limitation of conventional predistortion.

摘要翻译

我们研究了单层石墨烯中偶分母分数量子霍尔（even-denominator fractional quantum Hall, EDFQH）态，重点关注实验观测到的填充因子 \( \nu = 1/2 \) 和 \( \nu = 1/4 \)。由于自旋和谷自由度带来的近似 SU(4) 对称性，石墨烯中存在多种具有不同极化构型的多分量分数量子霍尔态。利用适用于 SU(4) 体系的陈-西蒙斯复合费米子（Chern-Simons composite fermion）框架，我们构造了对应于不同自旋、谷及混合极化态的候选变分波函数。在球面几何中采用库仑相互作用，对这些态的基态能量进行了数值计算。通过比较不同极化扇区的能量，我们确定了在 \( \nu = 1/2 \) 和 \( \nu = 1/4 \) 处能量上占优的构型。变分能量比较结果表明，能量上占优的候选态对应多分量关联量子霍尔液体。在本文所考虑的受限试探态族内，这些态不同于简单的复合费米子费米海描述。这些发现为理解谷极化和 SU(4) 对称性在稳定石墨烯中偶分母分数量子霍尔态方面的作用提供了启示。

Abstract

We investigate even-denominator fractional quantum Hall (EDFQH) states in monolayer graphene, focusing on the experimentally observed filling fractions $ν= 1/2$ and $ν= 1/4$. Owing to the approximate SU(4) symmetry arising from spin and valley degrees of freedom, graphene hosts a rich variety of multi-component fractional quantum Hall states with different polarization configurations. Using the Chern-Simons composite fermion framework for SU(4) systems, we construct candidate variational wave functions corresponding to distinct spin, valley, and mixed polarization states. The ground-state energies of these states are evaluated numerically using the Coulomb interaction in spherical geometry. By comparing energies across different polarization sectors, we identify the energetically favored configurations at $ν= 1/2$ and $ν= 1/4$. Our variational energy comparison suggests that the energetically favored candidate states correspond to multi-component correlated quantum Hall liquids. Within the restricted family of trial states considered here, these states differ from a simple composite-fermion Fermi-sea description. These findings provide insight into the role of valley polarization and SU(4) symmetry in stabilizing even-denominator fractional quantum Hall states in graphene.

TL;DR: This paper investigates how the number of hBN layers tunes the Hahn-echo coherence time of a boron-vacancy qubit, showing that a monolayer increases T2 from 199 ns to 653 ns and establishing layer number as a design parameter for sensing.
摘要翻译

六方氮化硼(hBN)中的带负电硼空位(VB^-)是范德瓦尔斯(van der Waals)晶体中首个被确认的光学可寻址自旋量子比特，因而可相对目标物在原子尺度上进行精准定位。在体相hBN中，其相干性受限于缺陷平面两侧层中的硼原子核，而薄层样品可消除该限制。本文采用纳入扩展中心自旋块的广义团簇关联展开(generalized cluster-correlation expansion)，计算了h^11B^15N中VB^-的哈恩回波(Hahn echo)相干时间随层数的变化。结果表明，T2由体相极限下的199 ns升至单层中的653 ns，为3.3倍；该提升在三层时已饱和，子格分解显示其完全来源于硼原子核。上述增强仅存在于低磁场区域，对层间堆叠构型与扭转角不敏感，但要求对准角度不超过约两度——这一起始条件(onset)无需任何自由参数即可重现。在动力学去耦条件下，以1/e为测量阈值时，各厚度均给出206 ns；但该点实为第一壳层核调制的零点而非相干衰减：若不以该阈值截取测量，不同层数间的对比仍然存在，且可达170倍。因此，层数成为基于VB^-的传感设计中的一项重要参数。

Abstract

The negatively charged boron vacancy ($\VB$) in hexagonal boron nitride (\hBN{}) was the first optically addressable spin qubit identified inside a van der Waals crystal, allowing atomically defined placement relative to a target. Its coherence in bulk \hBN{} is limited by the boron nuclei of the layers flanking the defect plane, which a thin flake removes. Here, we use a generalized cluster-correlation expansion with an extended central-spin block to calculate the Hahn-echo coherence time of $\VB$ in h$^{11}$B$^{15}$N as a function of layer number. Our results show that $T_2$ rises from $199\ns$ in the bulk limit to $653\ns$ in a monolayer, a factor of $3.3$ that is already saturated at three layers and that a sublattice decomposition attributes entirely to boron. The enhancement is confined to low field, is insensitive to stacking registry and twist angle, and requires alignment to within about two degrees, an onset we reproduce with no free parameters. Under dynamical decoupling, a $1/e$ threshold returns $206\ns$ for every thickness, but this is a zero of the first-shell modulation rather than a decay: measured without a threshold, the layer contrast survives and reaches a factor of $170$. Layer number thus emerges as a design parameter for $\VB$-based sensing.

Published: 2026-09-03

TL;DR: The paper introduces a polynomial classical algorithm that uses graph-theoretic properties to efficiently estimate the reduced dynamical Lie algebra and certify maximal expressibility of symmetry-reduced QAOA on trees, providing a pre-hardware diagnostic for variational quantum optimization.
摘要翻译

优化问题的经典等价表述未必会导致等价的量子算法。对于MaxCut，固定单个顶点的值会移除一个简单的全局对称性，而不改变底层的优化问题，但它可能显著改变由量子近似优化算法（QAOA）生成的量子动力学。这些动力学由电路的动力学李代数（DLA）刻画，其直接构造可能呈指数级昂贵。在此我们证明，对于树上的对称约化QAOA，约化DLA的大量信息反而可以仅从图结构高效获取。我们提出一种多项式经典算法，利用最短路径结构和度奇偶性递归区分顶点。当所有顶点被逐一区分时，该方法确定完整的约化DLA，并在相应的图条件下认证约化QAOA拟设的最大表达能力。即使未实现完全区分，该算法也能识别嵌入子代数，提供DLA维数的严格下界，并认证可控子系统。我们的理论和实验结果表明，在量子硬件上运行变分算法之前，可以利用经典图结构来诊断并潜在地指导其量子动力学。

Abstract

Classically equivalent formulations of an optimization problem need not lead to equivalent quantum algorithms. For MaxCut, fixing the value of a single vertex removes a simple global symmetry without changing the underlying optimization problem, yet it can substantially alter the quantum dynamics generated by the Quantum Approximate Optimization Algorithm (QAOA). These dynamics are captured by the circuit's dynamical Lie algebra (DLA), whose direct construction can become exponentially expensive. Here we show that, for symmetry-reduced QAOA on trees, substantial information about the reduced DLA can instead be obtained efficiently from the graph alone. We introduce a polynomial classical algorithm that recursively distinguishes vertices using shortest path structure and degree parity. When all vertices are resolved individually, the method determines the complete reduced DLA and, under the corresponding graph conditions, certifies maximal expressibility of the reduced QAOA ansatz. Even when full resolution is not achieved, the algorithm identifies embedded subalgebras, provides rigorous lower bounds on DLA dimension, and certifies controllable subsystems. Our theoretical and experimental results show how classical graph structure can be used to diagnose and potentially guide the quantum dynamics of variational algorithms before running them on quantum hardware.

Authors: Noah Berthusen, Ali Lavasani, Asmae Benhemou, M. S. Allman, Joan Dreiling, Brian Estey, Cameron Foltz, Trent Jacobs, Michael Mills, Annie Jihyun Park, Adam P. Reed, David Hayes, Tzvetan S. Metodi, Andrew C. Potter

TL;DR: 该论文在98量子比特离子阱处理器上实验验证了基于C4-Helix码的紧凑容错架构，展示了低于物理基线的逻辑量子纠错、完整Clifford群操作和异质GHZ态制备，证明该架构可超越量子存储器而用于早期容错计算。
摘要翻译

量子纠错（Quantum error correction, QEC）正开始实现超越其未编码物理对应实现的逻辑运算，但有用的容错计算将不仅需要低错误率的量子存储。一个有效的架构必须协调高效的逻辑编码、低开销的逻辑运算，以及对通用计算所必需的非Clifford资源（non-Clifford resources）的访问。在此，我们介绍并实验验证了一种基于$[[20,2,6]]$ $C_4$-Helix码的架构，该码专为早期容错体系设计。利用一台98量子比特的离子阱量子处理器Quantinuum Helios，我们实验演示了这一架构的主要组成部分：我们重复进行量子纠错，在每次QEC周期中每个逻辑量子比特的错误率为$4.6^{+6.2}_{-2.6}\times10^{-5}$。我们在主动纠错下对单个码块的两个逻辑量子比特上的完整Clifford群进行了基准测试，得到每次两比特逻辑Clifford运算的错误率为$2.8^{+1.0}_{-1.6}\times10^{-4}$。我们还展示了$C_4$-Helix与距离5表面码（surface code）之间的容错链映射（chain-map）接口，制备了一个三逻辑量子比特异构GHZ态，其保真度下界为$99.925^{+0.068}_{-0.245}\%$。在每种情况下，编码实现的性能均优于对应的未编码物理基线，且不依赖于后选择（postselection）。电路级模拟表明，物理保真度的改进将该架构带入为早期容错计算设定的$10^{-6}$-$10^{-8}$逻辑错误区域。这些结果共同确立了$C_4$-Helix是一种经硬件验证的容错架构，而非裸量子存储器。

Abstract

Quantum error correction (QEC) is beginning to enable logical operations that outperform their unencoded physical counterparts, but useful fault-tolerant computation will require more than low-error quantum memory. An effective architecture must orchestrate efficient logical encoding, low-overhead logical operations, and access to the non-Clifford resources required for universal computation. Here, we introduce and experimentally validate such an architecture based on the $[[20,2,6]]$ $C_4$-Helix code, designed for the early fault-tolerant regime. Using Quantinuum Helios, a 98-qubit trapped-ion quantum processor, we experimentally demonstrate the principal components of this architecture: we perform repeated quantum error correction with an error of $4.6^{+6.2}_{-2.6}\times10^{-5}$ per logical qubit per QEC cycle. We benchmark the complete Clifford group on the two logical qubits of a single codeblock under active error correction, obtaining an error of $2.8^{+1.0}_{-1.6}\times 10^{-4}$ per two-qubit logical Clifford. We further demonstrate a fault-tolerant chain-map interface between $C_4$-Helix and a distance-5 surface code, preparing a heterogeneous three-logical-qubit GHZ state with a fidelity lower bound of $99.925^{+0.068}_{-0.245}\%$. In each case, the encoded implementation outperforms its corresponding unencoded physical baseline without relying on postselection. Circuit-level simulations indicate that improvements in physical fidelity bring the same architecture into the $10^{-6}$-$10^{-8}$ logical-error regime targeted for early fault-tolerant computation. Together, these results establish $C_4$-Helix as a hardware-validated fault-tolerant architecture rather than a bare quantum memory.

TL;DR: 该论文提出一种结合经典图约简与量子引导优化的混合方法用于求解大规模最大独立集问题，并在天然气合同选择实例上实现了高近似比，展示了当前量子硬件下的实际应用潜力。
摘要翻译

选择相互兼容的天然气运输合同是一项实际重要的优化任务，运营商必须在时间、基础设施和流量相关约束下从众多候选协议中进行选择。随着候选数量的增长，由此产生的搜索空间变得难以穷举探索。我们研究了该任务的一种成对抽象，将其形式化为合同兼容图上的最大团问题（Maximum Clique），或等价地视为补图上的最大独立集（Maximum Independent Set, MIS）问题。 基于近期工作，本文研究了一种在噪声量子硬件限制内求解大规模MIS实例的量子-经典框架。该方法将迭代经典图约简与量子引导优化相结合，逐步简化搜索空间，同时保持较高的解质量。这使得大型候选空间能够被约简为更适合在当前量子计算机上执行的较小子问题。 我们在量子优化基准库（QOBLIB）的十五个基准实例上评估了该方法，平均近似比达到0.996，并在十四个实例中恢复出最优解，其中包括顶点数多达186的图。我们还在六个合成的成对合同兼容图上进一步评估了该算法，这些图包含多达900个合同；该方法平均近似比为0.989，并在四个案例中获得了最优解。这些实验证明了该混合MIS求解器对由工业问题驱动的图进行约简的能力。该成对抽象是两阶段筛选过程的第一步，它将候选合同缩小为较小的相互兼容的集合，随后可进一步根据管道容量约束进行验证。

Abstract

Selecting mutually compatible natural gas transportation contracts is a practically important optimization task in which operators must choose from many candidate agreements subject to temporal, infrastructural, and flow-related constraints. As the number of candidates grows, the resulting search space becomes difficult to explore exhaustively. We study a pairwise abstraction of this task, formulated as a Maximum Clique problem on a contract-compatibility graph, or equivalently as a Maximum Independent Set (MIS) problem on the complement graph. Building on recent work, this paper studies a quantum-classical framework for solving large-scale MIS instances within the limitations of noisy quantum hardware. The approach combines iterative classical graph reduction with quantum-guided optimization to progressively simplify the search space while maintaining high solution quality. This enables large candidate spaces to be reduced to smaller subproblems that are more suitable for execution on current quantum computers. We evaluate the approach on fifteen benchmark instances from the Quantum Optimization Benchmarking Library (QOBLIB), obtaining an average approximation ratio of 0.996 and recovering optimal solutions for fourteen instances, including graphs with up to 186 vertices. We further evaluate the algorithm on six synthetic pairwise contract-compatibility graphs containing up to 900 contracts, where the proposed method achieves an average approximation ratio of 0.989 and obtains optimal solutions in four cases. These experiments demonstrate the ability of the hybrid MIS solver to reduce industrially motivated graphs. The pairwise abstraction serves as the first step of a two-stage screening procedure that narrows the candidate contracts to a smaller set of mutually compatible ones, which can then be verified against pipeline-capacity constraints.

TL;DR: 该论文展示了利用金刚石中约10^4个NV色心强相互作用的电子自旋的集体多体动力学，实现纳米尺度磁场和磁噪声传感，获得最高7.9 dB和8.8 dB的计量增益，并实现可调长度尺度低至50纳米的动量空间分辨传感。
摘要翻译

多体动力学为在量子粒子之间产生关联提供了一种有前景的方法，可用于传感和计量学应用。然而，在实际场景中利用这一潜力获得显著增益是一项具有挑战性的任务，迄今仅实现了极少数应用。在此，我们展示了一种由室温固体中强相互作用的电子自旋实现的纳米级磁传感方法。通过使用脉冲磁场梯度对金刚石中约 \(10^4\) 个氮-空位（NV）色心的偶极 ensembles 的集体多体动力学进行相干控制，我们展示了实际计量增益，对于磁场信号检测可达 \(7.9(2)\,\mathrm{dB}\)，对于磁噪声传感可达 \(8.8(3)\,\mathrm{dB}\)，且完全计入实验开销。最后，我们结合这些方法展示了一种动量空间分辨的传感模式，能够在连续可调的长度尺度（低至50纳米）下检测空间相关的磁噪声。这些观察结果为基于相互作用增强的量子传感器在纳米级生物成像和材料表征中的实际应用打开了大门。

Abstract

Many-body dynamics constitutes a promising approach for creating correlations between quantum particles which can be used for applications in sensing and metrology. However, utilizing this potential for substantial gains in practical settings is a challenging task with only a very few applications realized to date. Here, we demonstrate an approach to nanoscale magnetic sensing enabled by strongly interacting electronic spins in a room temperature solid. By coherently controlling collective many-body dynamics of a dipolar ensemble of $\sim 10^4$ nitrogen-vacancy (NV) centres in diamond with pulsed magnetic field gradients, we demonstrate practical metrological gain up to $7.9(2)\,\mathrm{dB}$ for magnetic signal detection and $8.8(3)\,\mathrm{dB}$ for magnetic noise sensing, fully accounting for experimental overheads. Finally, we combine these methods to demonstrate a momentum-space-resolved sensing modality that enables detection of spatially correlated magnetic noise at continuously tunable length scales down to 50 nanometers. These observations open the door toward practical applications of interaction-enhanced quantum sensors for nanoscale biological imaging and material characterization.

TL;DR: 该论文提出了一个算子代数框架，分析了紧致对称性下单向量子自动机行为记忆的结构，揭示了非对易性导致的单态最坏情形代价，并证明了不同对称性可使记忆规模从多项式变为指数。
摘要翻译

在紧致对称性（compact symmetry）下，可观测行为归结为一个不变算子代数（invariant operator algebra），但其维数尚非经典记忆：有些坐标在动力学上被冻结，有些对阈值测试不可见，有些则已经是经典的。我们发展了一种算子代数理论，通过三个滤波器将这些效应分离。对单个自动机而言，行为是前缀可达状态与后缀可观测效应之间的Hilbert–Schmidt配对；在不需要可控性或可观测性假设时，其秩等于实Hankel秩。在一类受对称约束的动力学上最大化该不变量，可得到由对称中心化子（symmetry commutant）控制的结构容量：其中心存储着被可逆动力学冻结的等型布居数（isotypic population），其无迹重数块携带可移动的非交换坐标；耗散会移除这些块内部的一元谱损失（unary spectral loss），而协变移动性则在分量守恒约束下释放相对布居数。操作实现随后决定哪些存留坐标会迫使状态具有概率性。对于固定的非平凡不变读出，完全移动性在最坏情形状态代价上给出精确的二分法：交换不变代数的状态代价恰好等于其维数，而非交换重数块会把无约束代价恰好提高一个状态。因此，非交换性具有一个状态的最坏情形经典代价。在平凡对称性下，已知的四字母“二次加一”定律正是该原理的完全移动端点。Schur–Weyl对偶进一步表明，在同一张量幂Hilbert空间上，不同的保持对称性可将最坏记忆尺度从多项式变为指数；而固定权模块在半填充处给出精确的Catalan定律，其结构容量等于Catalan数减去中心扇区修正项。

Abstract

Under compact symmetry, observable behavior reduces to an invariant operator algebra, but its dimension is not yet classical memory: some coordinates are dynamically frozen, some invisible to threshold tests, and some already classical. We develop an operator-algebraic theory that separates these effects through three filters. For one automaton, behavior is the Hilbert--Schmidt pairing between prefix-reachable states and suffix-observable effects, whose rank equals the real Hankel rank without controllability or observability assumptions. Maximizing this invariant over a symmetry-constrained dynamical class gives a structural capacity controlled by the symmetry commutant: its center stores isotypic populations frozen by reversible dynamics, its traceless multiplicity blocks carry movable noncommutative coordinates, dissipation removes the unary spectral loss inside those blocks, and covariant mobility releases relative populations subject to component conservation. Operational realization then determines which surviving coordinates force probabilistic states. For a fixed nontrivial invariant readout, full mobility gives an exact dichotomy in worst-case state cost: a commutative invariant algebra costs exactly its dimension, whereas a noncommutative multiplicity block raises the unrestricted cost by exactly one state. Thus noncommutativity has a one-state worst-case classical price. The known four-letter quadratic-plus-one law at trivial symmetry is the fully mobile endpoint of this principle. Schur--Weyl duality further shows that different preserved symmetries on the same tensor-power Hilbert space can change the worst memory scale from polynomial to exponential, while fixed-weight modules give an exact Catalan law at half filling, with structural capacity equal to the Catalan count minus its central-sector correction.

量子密钥分发（Quantum Key Distribution, QKD）基于量子物理定律提供信息论上安全的密钥建立，但其实际应用范围受到光子硬件高昂成本及现有仿真工具碎片化特性的限制。大多数仿真器仅支持单一协议，并报告来自单次随机运行的结果，这使得系统性的协议比较和可重复的统计推断变得困难。本文提出了一个统一的QKD仿真平台，在单一的Python/Qiskit引擎中实现了BB84、B92、E91和BBM92四种基础协议。共享损伤模型涵盖光纤衰减、源与探测器损耗、偏振漂移以及可配置的拦截-重发窃听。该平台通过两个共享同一后端的独立接口供访问：用于本地实验的桌面应用程序（Tkinter、Matplotlib）以及用于免安装远程访问的基于浏览器的Web客户端（React、Node.js/Express）。所有报告结果均来自重复运行研究（20次独立运行，每次10,000个量子比特），并全程给出平均值、标准差和95%置信区间。在25 km光纤链路上，BB84实现了最高的平均密钥率160,045 Hz，其次是BBM92（80,023 Hz）、E91（52,815 Hz）和B92（40,011 Hz），这一排序与仿真得到的筛选效率精确对应。在E91协议下，CHSH S统计量在基线状态时平均为2.12，激活窃听者后降至1.58，证明基于贝尔不等式的入侵检测不依赖QBER。

Abstract

Quantum Key Distribution (QKD) offers information- theoretically secure key establishment grounded in the laws of quantum physics, yet its practical reach is limited by the prohibitive cost of photonic hardware and the fragmented nature of existing simulation tools. Most simulators support only a single protocol and report results from individual stochastic runs, making systematic protocol comparison and reproducible statistical inference difficult. This paper presents a unified QKD simulation platform that implements four foundational protocols BB84, B92, E91, and BBM92 within a single Python/Qiskit engine. A shared impairment model covers fiber attenuation, source and detector losses, po- larization drift, and configurable intercept-resend eavesdropping. The platform is accessible through two independent interfaces that share the same backend: a desktop application (Tkinter, Matplotlib) for local experimentation and a browser-based web client (React, Node.js/Express) for zero-install remote access. All reported results are drawn from repeated-run studies (20 independent runs, 10000 qubits each), with mean, standard deviation, and 95% confidence intervals stated throughout. At a 25 km fiber link, BB84 achieves the highest mean key-rate of 160,045 Hz, followed by BBM92 (80023 Hz), E91 (52815 Hz), and B92 (40011 Hz) ordering that tracks simulation-derived sifting efficiencies precisely. Under the E91 protocol, the CHSH S-statistic averages 2.12 at baseline and falls to 1.58 when an eavesdropper is activated, demonstrating Bell-inequality-based intrusion detection independent of QBER

Abstract

This paper introduces QXymb, a general framework for constructing observational declarative twins of quantum circuits, and develops QILP-0, its first complete order-0 specialization. QILP-0 constructs a finite multi-valued propositional logic program from observed circuit behaviour within a declared observational scope. The pipeline traverses a declared family of quantum observables incrementally according to a reproducible structural grading and a declared observational reference horizon. Progress is quantified through reference-relative coverage against a fixed target-independent reference. Observable responses are organized through target-independent geometry, while retained latent structure is mapped deterministically back to original observable columns before symbolic processing, preserving observational semantics and provenance. Selected observable profiles are converted into a finite relation through admissible target-independent discretization. The target is used only afterwards to audit twin-admissibility and induce the declarative theory. A theory is certified as an exact observational declarative twin when it completely and correctly reconstructs the resulting finite task-conditioned discrete relation. Logical exactness is therefore separated from numerical, backend, provider, and discretization uncertainty, which is retained as audit metadata. Validation uses two complementary QML settings. Exhaustive Bars & Stripes experiments compare product and grid-CZ embeddings from 16 to 100 qubits and exercise the native-discrete branch. Low-Depth MNIST analyses all 14,708 digit-0/1 instances before and after a trained variational quantum transformation and exercises continuous discretization. In every reported relation, the induced QILP-0 theory achieves complete, conflict-free reconstruction with strict accuracy equal to one.

摘要翻译

我们发展了量子能量隐形传态在一维谐振子链中的有限温度高斯态形式。对于吉布斯态，优化的测量-反馈协议简化为热两点函数。在单位点协议中，提取的能量由单个关联函数控制，这使得热力学极限和近临界极限在解析上易于处理。在固定有限温度下，提取的能量随距离呈指数屏蔽，并由热关联长度控制，无论$α$是临界还是非临界。在热力学极限之后取零温临界极限时，我们推导出精确的渐近律$E_{\mathrm{ext}}\sim d^{-4}$。数值结果确认了这两种区域，并解析了造成中等距离处有效衰减指数表观漂移的交叉行为。我们还分析了压缩高斯测量，并表明它们修改了提取的前因子：$p$压缩增强提取能量，而$q$压缩抑制提取能量，但不改变大距离标度。

Abstract

We develop a finite-temperature Gaussian-state formulation of quantum energy teleportation in the one-dimensional harmonic chain. For Gibbs states, the optimized measurement-feedback protocol reduces to thermal two-point functions. In the single-site protocol, the extracted energy is governed by a single correlator, which makes the thermodynamic and near-critical limits analytically tractable. At fixed finite temperature, the extracted energy is exponentially screened with distance and is controlled by a thermal correlation length for both critical and non-critical $α$. In the zero-temperature critical limit taken after the thermodynamic limit, we derive the exact asymptotic law $E_{\mathrm{ext}}\sim d^{-4}$. Numerical results confirm both regimes and resolve the crossover responsible for the apparent drift of the effective decay exponent at intermediate distances. We also analyze squeezed Gaussian measurements and show that they modify the extraction prefactor: $p-$squeezing enhances the extracted energy, whereas $q-$squeezing suppresses it, without changing the large-distance scaling.

摘要翻译

设 $D=2^n$，$M=3n+9\binom n2$。我们研究 $\operatorname{PU}(D)$ 上右不变的单步悬崖度量 $d_Q$，其中对 Pauli 权重 1 和 2 的惩罚为 1，对所有更高权重的惩罚为 $Q$。若 $M/Q_D\to0$ 且 $MQ_D^{3/4}/D^2\to0$，则对每个固定的 $0<x<\pi/\sqrt3$，有 \[ \mu_D\bigl(B_{Q_D}([I],x\sqrt{Q_D})\bigr)\le e^{-c_xD^2}. \] 这里 $\mu_D$ 是归一化 Haar 测度。因而在整个区间 $M\ll Q_D\ll D^{8/3}M^{-4/3}$ 内，从单位元出发的 Haar 典型距离以及直径均渐近于 $(\pi/\sqrt3)\sqrt{Q_D}$。若取 $Q_D=\kappa D^{8/3}M^{-4/3}$，其中 $\kappa>0$ 为足够小的固定常数，则在某个 $e^{-\Omega(D^2)}$ 例外集之外，相应的无限悬崖 Carnot–Carathéodory 距离具有阶为 $D^{4/3}M^{-2/3}$ 的 Haar 典型下界。因此，无限悬崖直径的指数下界速率至少为 $4/3$，这否证了 Brown 的指数为一猜想。同一估计还给出同阶的固定误差、无辅助比特两比特量子电路下界。

Abstract

Let $D=2^n$ and $M=3n+9\binom n2$. We study the right-invariant one-step-cliff metric $d_Q$ on $\operatorname{PU}(D)$, with unit penalty on Pauli weights one and two and penalty $Q$ on all higher weights. If $M/Q_D\to0$ and $MQ_D^{3/4}/D^2\to0$, then, for every fixed $0<x<π/\sqrt3$, \[ μ_D\bigl(B_{Q_D}([I],x\sqrt{Q_D})\bigr)\le e^{-c_xD^2}. \] Here $μ_D$ is normalized Haar measure. Thus the Haar-typical distance from the identity and the diameter are both asymptotic to $(π/\sqrt3)\sqrt{Q_D}$ throughout the window $M\ll Q_D\ll D^{8/3}M^{-4/3}$. Choosing $Q_D=κD^{8/3}M^{-4/3}$ with sufficiently small fixed $κ>0$ yields a Haar-typical lower bound of order $D^{4/3}M^{-2/3}$ for the corresponding infinite-cliff Carnot--Carathéodory distance, outside an $e^{-Ω(D^2)}$ exceptional set. The infinite-cliff diameter therefore has exponential lower rate at least $4/3$, disproving Brown's exponent-one conjecture. The same estimate gives a fixed-error no-ancilla two-qubit circuit lower bound of the same order.

TL;DR: 本研究在超导谐振器与Transmon系统中实现了可编程非高斯相位门，实验验证了立方相位门、可调双阱势及Morse门，为连续变量量子信息处理和非简谐势的量子模拟提供了可重构的实验平台。
摘要翻译

连续变量量子系统为通用量子信息处理以及真实世界过程（如分子物理和化学反应）的类比量子模拟提供了一条资源高效的路径。然而，实现这些应用需要实现非高斯操作以产生非简谐势，而这些操作按需工程化极具挑战。在此，我们展示了一个系统化框架，用于在由transmon量子比特耦合的超导谐振子中实现可编程的非高斯相位门 \(e^{-iV(\hat{X})}\)，其对应势能 \(V(\hat{X})\) 的脉冲作用。利用源自玻色子量子信号处理的模块化电路，我们通过改变一组与固定校准控制酉操作交错排列的量子比特旋转，在单一硬件上实现了多种目标非简谐势。我们首先演示了三次相位门，这是通用量子信息处理的关键要素。由此产生的高保真非高斯态以及使用我们开发的逐点力重构方法重建的势能共同确认了目标门的立方特性。随后，我们工程化了一族双阱势，这是隧穿和偏置转移过程的相关模型，并实验验证了双阱拓扑结构及可调的不对称性。最后，我们工程化了一个近似的Morse门，朝分子振动系统真实势能工程迈出了一步，并为指数形式的高质量工程化与重构提供了具体路径。综上，这些结果为连续变量量子信息处理和非简谐量子模拟建立了一条实用且可重构的路线。

Abstract

Continuous-variable quantum systems offer a resource-efficient route to universal quantum information processing and analogue quantum simulation of real-world processes, such as molecular physics and chemical reactions. Realising these applications, however, requires non-Gaussian operations that implement anharmonic potentials, which are challenging to engineer on demand. Here, we demonstrate a systematic framework to implement programmable non-Gaussian phase gates $e^{-iV(\hat{X})}$, corresponding to the impulsive action of a potential $V(\hat{X})$, in a superconducting harmonic oscillator coupled to a transmon qubit. Using modular circuits derived from bosonic quantum signal processing, we realise a range of target anharmonic potentials on a single piece of hardware by varying a set of qubit rotations interleaved with a fixed calibrated control unitary. We first demonstrate a cubic phase gate, a key ingredient for universal quantum information processing. The resulting high-fidelity non-Gaussian states and the potential reconstructed using our pointwise force reconstruction method jointly confirm the cubic nature of the target gate. We then engineer a family of double-well potentials, relevant models of tunnelling and biased transfer processes, and experimentally validate the double-well topology and the tunable asymmetry. Finally, we engineer an approximate Morse gate, a step towards realistic potentials of molecular vibrational systems, and provide a concrete path towards high-quality engineering and reconstruction of the exponential form. Together, these results establish a practical and reconfigurable route towards continuous-variable quantum information processing and anharmonic quantum simulation.

TL;DR: 该论文将N-bein形式推广至处理简并量子态的参数空间几何，引入非阿贝尔两态量子几何张量与挠率概念，并应用于电场中耦合谐振子系统以揭示态间关联。
摘要翻译

最近，我们引入了一种几何对象，类似于Cartan形式体系中的标准正交标架，用以研究量子系统的参数空间；我们将其称为\(\mathcal{N}\)-bein，其中\(\mathcal{N}\)是表征量子系统的参数数目。作为量子几何张量（QGT）的“平方根”，\(\mathcal{N}\)-bein使我们能够定义新的张量，从而加深对量子力学参数空间底层结构的理解。在本工作中，我们扩展了这一围绕\(\mathcal{N}\)-bein的数学框架，以分析具有简并谱的量子系统的参数空间。与非简并情形类似，我们定义了一个非阿贝尔两态QGT，用以识别两次连续参数变化后简并态之间可能发生的跃迁。此外，利用Wilczek-Zee联络，我们引入了一个类似挠率的张量，作为\(\mathcal{N}\)-bein的协变导数。该挠率捕捉了连续参数变化的非对易性，并与两态QGT的反对称部分一致。我们还给出了一个使用微分形式的几何表述，并讨论了新定义张量的物理意义。进一步地，我们从\(\mathcal{N}\)-bein及其导数构造了若干规范不变的观测量，以突显新张量的实用性。最后，为了说明该形式体系的便捷性与应用，我们将这一理论框架应用于浸在电场中的耦合谐振子系统。谐振子之间的耦合导致系统出现简并。因此，利用新形式体系，我们发现了由新不变量量化的量子态之间的关联。

Abstract

Recently, we introduced a geometric object analogous to an orthonormal frame in the Cartan formalism to study the parameter space of quantum systems; we called it $\mathcal{N}$-bein, with $\mathcal{N}$ being the number of parameters that characterize the quantum system. Acting as the ``square root'' of the quantum geometric tensor (QGT), the $\mathcal{N}$-bein allows us to define new tensors to improve our understanding of the structure beneath the parameter space of quantum mechanics. In this work, we extend this mathematical framework surrounding the $\mathcal{N}$-bein to analyze the parameter space of quantum systems with degenerate spectra. As in the non-degenerate case, we define a non-Abelian two-state QGT to identify possible transitions between degenerate states after two consecutive parameter variations. Additionally, using the Wilczek-Zee connection, we introduce a torsion-like tensor as the covariant derivative of the $\mathcal{N}$-bein. This torsion captures the noncommutativity of successive parameter variations and coincides with the antisymmetric part of the two-state QGT. We also present a geometrical formulation using differential forms and discuss the physical implications of the newly defined tensors. Furthermore, we construct several gauge-invariant observables from the $\mathcal{N}$-bein and its derivatives to highlight the utility of the new tensors. Finally, to illustrate the convenience and applications of this formalism, we apply the theoretical framework to a system of coupled harmonic oscillators immersed in an electric field. The coupling between the oscillators results in a degenerate system. Thus, using the new formalism, we found correlations among the quantum states quantified by the new invariants.

TL;DR: This paper analyzes the tradeoff between success probability and state fidelity in non-destructive discrimination of two-mode squeezed vacuum states using local Gaussian measurements, and shows that pre-shared entanglement can surpass the standard local Gaussian bound.
摘要翻译

在量子系统中，典型的测量设置是破坏性的，这意味着量子态在测量后被不可逆地改变。在本工作中，我们分析了利用局域高斯测量对两个双模压缩真空态进行非破坏性判别的问题。我们研究了判别成功概率与所得量子态相对于初始态的保真度之间的权衡关系，并构建了一个由局域高斯测量给出的方案，该方案在我们数值探索的类别中是最优的。我们还进一步考虑了允许额外预共享纠缠的情形，并表明该情形使我们能够超越标准局域高斯测量在保真度-成功概率权衡上的界限。我们的工作将纠缠态判别中信息获取与扰动之间的权衡关系——此前已在有限维量子系统中确立——自然延伸至无限维连续变量系统。

Abstract

Typical measurement setups in quantum systems are destructive, meaning that states are irretrievably altered after measurement. In this work, we analyse non-destructive discrimination of two two-mode squeezed vacuum states using local Gaussian measurements. We investigate a tradeoff relation between the success probability of discrimination and the fidelity of the resulting state with the initial state, and construct a protocol given by local Gaussian measurements, which is optimal within our numerically explored class. We also extend to the case where we allow for additional pre-shared entanglement, and show that this regime allows us to exceed the standard local Gaussian bound for the fidelity-success probability tradeoff. Our work provides a natural extension of the tradeoff between information gain and disturbance in entangled-state discrimination, previously established for finite-dimensional quantum systems, to infinite-dimensional continuous-variable systems.

摘要翻译

伪随机性日益被公认为量子信息论、统计力学以及量子多体物理中系综的关键性质。然而，它以两种概念上不同的形式出现：以酉设计（unitary designs）为代表的统计伪随机性，以及由伪随机酉算子（pseudorandom unitaries, PRUs）所刻画的计算伪随机性。这两种伪随机形式之间关系至今仍令人惊讶地缺乏理解。现存的PRU构造揭示了这种相互作用：统计随机化成分，即酉设计，与经典密码学原语结合以产生计算伪随机性。我们证明，统计伪随机性对于计算上伪随机的酉算子并非必要条件。为此，我们使用甚至不是态1-设计（state 1-designs）的系综来替代现有构造中的酉2-设计层，但这些系综具有足够的区分性（distinctness）——我们将这一性质认定为任何PRU所必需的。这产生了新的非自适应安全的PRU系综，其计算伪随机性是在没有诸如2-设计之类的底层统计伪随机量子系综的情况下获得的。我们通过反集中（anticoncentration）的纠缠类比来刻画区分性，并利用它表明，区分性已经涵盖了对PRU相干性和虚部性的约束，同时识别出大量输入类别；对于这些输入，后一种障碍消失，从而使得实值PRU甚至对某些（最大）纠缠态也成为可能。作为一项应用，我们利用区分性的缺失来约束随机相位-哈达玛系综构成PRU这一猜想。

Abstract

Pseudorandomness is increasingly recognized as a key property of ensembles in quantum information theory, statistical mechanics, and quantum many-body physics. Yet it appears in two conceptually different forms: statistical pseudorandomness, embodied by unitary designs, and computational pseudorandomness captured by pseudorandom unitaries (PRUs). The relationship between these two forms of pseudorandomness remains surprisingly poorly understood. Existing PRU constructions reveal this interplay where a statistically randomizing ingredient, a unitary design, is combined with classical cryptographic primitives to produce computational pseudorandomness. We show that statistical pseudorandomness is not necessary for computationally pseudorandom unitaries. We do this by replacing the unitary $2$-design layer in the existing constructions with ensembles that are not even state $1$-designs, yet are sufficiently {\em distinct}, a property we identify to be necessary for any PRU. This yields new non-adaptively secure PRU ensembles whose computational pseudorandomness is obtained without an underlying statistically pseudorandom quantum ensemble, such as a $2$-design. We characterize distinctness via an entangled analogue of anticoncentration and use it to show that distinctness already captures constraints on coherence and imaginarity of PRUs, while identifying broad classes of inputs for which the latter obstruction disappears, enabling real-valued PRUs even for certain (maximally) entangled states. As an application, we use lack of distinctness to constrain the conjectured pseudorandomness of the random phase-Hadamard ensemble to form a PRU.

摘要翻译

量子计算应用（如量子模拟和量子态层析成像(QST)）中的一项关键任务是将任意算子集合划分为相互对易的子集，以实现高效测量。然而，随着算子数量和维度的增长，暴力求解方法很快变得难以处理。在此，我们将算子划分重新表述为图着色(GC)问题，并开发了一个高效的求解计算框架，在准确性和效率之间取得平衡。我们的框架能够利用一系列图着色算法，并针对算子划分对其进行了基准测试。随后，我们展示了它们在优化QST实验中的实用性——在QST中确定不重叠的数据采集设置是一项重大挑战，并且需要对这些设置进行优先级排序，即选择能够提供最多信息的实验。我们进一步展示了如何通过在多量子比特系统中综合用于联合测量对易泡利算子的Clifford电路来执行这些实验。我们跨多量子比特（最多五个量子比特）、多量子三态系统（最多三个qutrit）以及混合qubit-qutrit系统验证了我们的框架。结果表明，启发式图着色方法显著减少了QST所需的测量设置数量，并实现了基于优先级的调度，从而最大化每次实验的信息增益。优化在普通学生笔记本电脑上仅需几分钟即可收敛，对于这些相对较小的量子系统，相比暴力方法已提供了几个数量级的加速。这证明了图着色启发式算法作为表征含噪中等规模量子设备的一种可扩展且实用工具的潜力。我们已将用于优化和调度QST实验的Python实现公开于https://github.com/ssm8015/QST_GT.git。

Abstract

A key task in many quantum-computing applications, e.g., quantum simulation and quantum state tomography (QST), is to partition an arbitrary set of operators into mutually commuting subsets for efficient measurements. However, brute-force approaches to this task quickly become intractable as the number and dimensionality of operators grow. Here, we reformulate operator partitioning as a graph-coloring (GC) problem and develop an efficient computational framework to solve it, balancing accuracy and efficiency. Our framework enables leveraging a range of GC algorithms, which we benchmark for operator partitioning. Then, we demonstrate their utility in optimizing QST experiments, where determining non-overlapping data acquisition settings for QST is a major challenge, and prioritizing among these settings, i.e., selecting the experiments that provide the most information. We further show how to perform these experiments by synthesizing Clifford circuits for joint measurement of commuting Pauli operators in multi-qubit systems. We validate our framework across multi-qubit (up to five qubits), multi-qutrit (up to three qutrits), and hybrid qubit-qutrit systems. Our results show that heuristic GC methods substantially reduce the number of required measurement settings for QST and enable priority-based scheduling that maximizes the information gain per experiment. The optimization converges within minutes on a student-grade laptop, providing speedups of several orders of magnitude over brute-force methods already for these relatively small quantum systems. This demonstrates the potential of GC heuristics as a scalable and practical tool for characterization of noisy intermediate-scale quantum devices. We have made the Python implementation of our GC framework to optimize and schedule QST experiments publicly available at https://github.com/ssm8015/QST_GT.git.

84. Exact Virtual Channel Programming with Vanishing Excess Overhead FAIL

Authors: Mingrui Jing, Mengbo Guo, Hongshun Yao, Xin Wang
Published: 2026-09-01

TL;DR: 本文证明了有限维物理处理器无法以零开销精确编程连续幺正信道，并针对Choi态存储的场景构造了目标无关的精确重构协议，证明最优单拷贝采样开销随维度二次增长，且额外开销随Choi程序数反比消失。
摘要翻译

有限维物理处理器无法精确地编程一族连续且互不相同的幺正信道（unitary channels）。我们证明，当目标信道存储于归一化Choi态（normalized Choi state）中，并通过采样物理信道并对其测量结果进行经典后处理来重建其输出可观测量时，这一障碍会变为定量的。对于任意$d$维信道，我们构造了一个与目标无关的精确重建协议，并证明了最优单副本采样开销，该开销随系统维度二次增长。我们还证明了固定$d$的精确律（sharp fixed-$d$ law）：额外开销反比于相同Choi程序（Choi program）的副本数而消失。该上界的实现结合了确定性基于端口的隐形传态（deterministic port-based teleportation）与一种纠正其退极化畸变的拟分解。反过来，我们将任意低开销重建协议映射为能够学习未知幺正的物理学习器，并利用局部量子估计恢复相同的前导系数。这些结果将普遍的不可编程障碍重新表述为量子程序存储与经典采样之间的定量权衡，其前导代价反映了局部可学习的幺正自由度。

Abstract

A finite-dimensional physical processor cannot exactly program a continuous family of distinct unitary channels. We show that this obstruction becomes quantitative when the target channel is stored in a normalized Choi state and its output observables are reconstructed by sampling physical channels and classically post-processing their measurement outcomes. For arbitrary $d$-dimensional channels, we construct a target-independent exact reconstruction protocol and prove the optimal one-copy sampling overhead, which grows quadratically with system dimension. We further prove the sharp fixed-$d$ law that the excess overhead vanishes inversely with the number of identical Choi programs. The upper bound combines deterministic port-based teleportation with a quasi-decomposition that corrects its depolarizing distortion. The converse maps any low-overhead reconstruction protocol to a physical learner of unknown unitaries and uses local quantum estimation to recover the same leading coefficient. These results recast the universal no-programming obstruction as a quantitative trade-off between quantum program memory and classical sampling, with a leading cost that reflects the locally learnable unitary degrees of freedom.

TL;DR: 该论文证明了时间翻转（不定时间方向）辅助的量子计量协议在有限和渐近多次信道使用下能够获得超过并行、自适应和因果叠加策略的量子Fisher信息，并针对一类Pauli噪声信道实现海森堡标度，从而确立时间翻转不可被传统电路模拟的真正资源地位。
摘要翻译

在量子计量学中，对于有限次信道使用，自适应策略和因果叠加策略已被证明优于并行方案，但它们的优势在渐近极限下消失。我们证明，具有不定时间方向的量子操作——具体而言，即时间翻转（TF）辅助策略，称为不定时间方向计量（ITDM）——能够克服这种渐近等价性。利用半定规划，我们严格证明了TF辅助协议在信道使用次数有限及渐近多的情况下，均可实现严格超过并行、自适应和因果叠加策略所能达到的最大值的量子费希尔信息（QFI）。此外，我们识别了一类泡利噪声信道：对于这类信道，ITDM可实现海森堡标度，而所有并行、自适应和因果叠加策略仍只能达到标准标度。我们将这一现象称为计量激活。有趣的是，这种激活还可用于表明：量子时间翻转和转置超映射无法通过使用任何有限次信道查询的常规量子电路或因果叠加策略来模拟，从而确立了不定时间方向是量子计量学中的一种真正资源。

Abstract

In quantum metrology, adaptive and causal-superposition strategies are proven to be beneficial over parallel schemes for a finite number of channel uses, but their advantages disappear in the asymptotic limit. We show that quantum operations with indefinite time direction, specifically, time-flip (TF)-assisted strategies, referred to as indefinite time-directed metrology (ITDM), can overcome this asymptotic equivalence. Using semidefinite programming, we rigorously demonstrate that TF-assisted protocols can achieve quantum Fisher information (QFI) strictly exceeding the maximum value attainable by parallel, adaptive, and causal-superposition strategies, both for finite and asymptotically many channel uses. Moreover, we identify a class of Pauli noise channels for which ITDM achieves Heisenberg scaling, while all parallel, adaptive, and causal-superposition strategies remain restricted to standard scaling. We call this phenomenon as metrological activation. Interestingly, this activation can be used to exhibit that the quantum time-flip and transposition supermaps cannot be simulated by conventional quantum circuits or causal-superposition strategies using any finite number of channel queries, thereby establishing indefinite time direction as a genuine resource for quantum metrology.

摘要翻译

光子聚变操作是光子量子信息处理中的核心基本操作，通常以其成功概率和资源成本为特征。在此，我们确定了聚变操作的不同实现方式之间另一个差异维度，即它们如何变换部分可区分性。我们考虑由不完美的纠缠资源态和不完美的单光子引起的可区分性。我们发现，不同的成功聚变事件可以根据聚变协议、宣告结果和误差模型的不同，诱导显著不同的可区分性变换。在集体资源态误差模型下，我们对现有聚变协议提出了一种修改方案，该方案平均上提高了剩余态的保真度。然而，总体而言，这些变换对可区分性产生不利影响，许多成功的聚变结果伴随着可区分性的退化。我们的结果表明，部分可区分性由干涉和测量动态塑造，在评估光子聚变协议时，应将其与整体聚变成功概率一并考虑。

Abstract

Photonic fusion operations are a central primitive in photonic quantum information processing and are commonly characterized by their success probability and resource cost. Here, we identify an additional way in which different implementations of fusion operations differ, namely in how they transform partial distinguishability. We consider distinguishability originating both from imperfect entangled resource states and from imperfect single photons. We find that different successful fusion events can induce markedly different distinguishability transformations depending on the fusion protocol, heralding outcome, and error model. Under a collective resource-state error model, we identify a modification to an existing fusion protocol that improves the fidelity of the remaining state on average. Generally, however, these transformations adversely affect distinguishability, and many successful fusion outcomes are accompanied by distinguishability degradation. Our results show that partial distinguishability is dynamically shaped by interference and measurements and should be considered alongside overall fusion success probability when evaluating photonic fusion protocols.
